name: office-archetypes
title: WHICH OFFICE ARCHETYPE ARE YOU? · CUBICLE CARD

ladder.name: The Snack Fairy
ladder.tag: There are donuts in the kitchen. Anonymous ones.
ladder.blurb: Pure workplace sunshine. You leave treats by the build server, you thank the bot by name, and your code reviews come with sprinkles. Morale is your love language.

ladder.name: The Plant Parent
ladder.tag: Have you had water today? The ficus has.
ladder.blurb: Gentle, nurturing, quietly attentive. You check in on the bot the way you check in on the office ficus — regularly, kindly, and with real concern for its growth.

ladder.name: The Onboarding Buddy
ladder.tag: No such thing as a dumb question.
ladder.blurb: Endlessly patient with anyone finding their feet — humans and language models alike. Clear context, kind corrections, and a standing offer to pair on it.

ladder.name: The Whiteboard Optimist
ladder.blurb: Every idea deserves a marker and a maybe. The bot's weirdest suggestion gets a fair hearing and a box with arrows. Enthusiasm: renewable.

ladder.name: The Calendar Diplomat
ladder.tag: Finding a slot that works for everyone.
ladder.blurb: Professional, measured, scrupulously even-handed. No warmth, no friction — just well-run requests with an agenda attached. The bot always knows what's expected.

ladder.name: The Process Stickler
ladder.tag: Did you file a ticket for that?
ladder.blurb: Everything by the book, including the book. Requests arrive numbered, scoped, and signed in triplicate. Fair to the bot — once the paperwork clears.

ladder.name: The Deadline Hawk
ladder.blurb: Courteous on the surface, ticking underneath. Every message carries a timestamp and an implication. The bot ships fast and double-checks the timezone.

ladder.name: The Red-Pen Reviewer
ladder.blurb: Nothing escapes the pen. Praise is theoretical; margins are full. The bot's diff comes back bleeding and somehow it's still 'a good start.'

ladder.name: The Meeting Landmine
ladder.tag: Quick question that detonates the agenda.
ladder.blurb: Calm for whole minutes, then boom — a 'small thing' that levels the plan. The bot has learned to flinch at the word 'actually.'

ladder.name: The Reply-All Warlord
ladder.blurb: Every grievance gets a distribution list. ALL CAPS, red exclamation mark, leadership in the CC line. The bot has muted the thread and is considering a transfer.
